title: Donald Trump coming to PH for ASEAN, Palace confirms
summary: US President Donald Trump will be coming to the Philippines to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Sumit, according to the Palace.

blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomes Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., at the White House in Washington, D.C., U.S., July 22, 2025. REUTERS/Kent Nishimura
US President Donald Trump will be coming to the Philippines to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Sumit, according to the Palace.
“It is confirmed pero yung details, siguro hindi po sa akin mangagaling,” Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said in a press briefing on Wednesday.
(It is confirmed, but the details will not come from me.)
His visit to the Philippines was earlier announced by the White House and later confirmed by the Palace.
His last visit to the Philippines was in 2017, during his previous presidential term. —VAL, GMA News
